plan.headline: Ride where the **signal ends**
plan.subline: Plan, route and navigate on your iPhone, even offline.

android.subline: Plan, route and navigate on your phone, even offline.

ipad.subline: Plan, route and navigate on your iPad, even offline.

variants.headline: Routes that fit **your bike**
variants.subline: Touring, road, gravel or MTB, with alternatives, elevation and surfaces.

weather.headline: See the rain **before you ride**
weather.subline: Rain radar, wind and clouds on the map, and the weather along your route for when you leave.

cyclemap.headline: Bike lanes on the map, **even offline**
cyclemap.subline: Lanes, routes, one-way arrows and more from the data you downloaded. Switch each part on or off.

navigation.headline: Every turn, **spoken aloud**
navigation.subline: Leave the route and choose: a way back, a new route, or nothing.

loops.headline: Out the door, **back for dinner**
loops.subline: Say how far. Velorki finds round trips from where you stand.

ai.headline: Describe it, **ride it**
ai.subline: Ask for a gravel loop with a café halfway, and get the route. Part of Velorki Plus.

ride.headline: Every climb **on the record**
ride.subline: Elevation, speed, heart rate and splits for every ride.

offline-themes.headline: Coffee and water, **signal or not**
offline-themes.subline: Stops along your route from the region you downloaded. Light or dark, any colour.

import.headline: Bring **any route** along
import.subline: Open GPX, FIT and TCX from anywhere. Export to GPX or FIT.

lock-screen.headline: Your ride on the **Lock Screen**
lock-screen.subline: Live figures on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

watch.headline: Start and stop **from your wrist**
watch.subline: Heart rate and the ride on your watch, in sync with your iPhone.
